page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.4xlarge is a storage and memory-focused instance driven by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor featuring 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores running at 2.5 GHz. The platform is configured with 128 GB of RAM, yielding an 8 GB per vCPU memory allocation ratio. Local SSD storage is integrated directly into the host with 3839 GB of total capacity, supplemented by a 5 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Supported CPU instructions include AVX-512, AES, FMA, and BMI2.

Benchmark results indicate average multi-core processing efficiency, achieving a score of 11,742.55 in multi-core stress-ng tests and 5,855.0 in Geekbench multi-core workloads. Single-core performance sits in lower percentiles, evidenced by a single-core stress-ng result of 1,103.88 and a Geekbench single-core score of 946.0. Memory read bandwidth measures 66.14 GB/sec for large block operations, while database throughput reaches 4,310.67 operations in PassMark database tests and 11.7 million SET operations per second in Redis benchmarks.

The instance delivers qualitative cost efficiency for IO-intensive operations by bundling 3839 GB of local SSD storage directly into the hardware profile, avoiding attached storage surcharges. However, lower single-threaded processing speeds present a performance tradeoff for compute-bound or single-threaded workloads. The server fits database engines, key-value caching layers, log aggregation systems, and static web serving workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.4xlarge is a high-density storage and memory instance powered by a 16-vCPU Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It provides 128 GB of RAM and 3839 GB of local SSD storage, backed by a 5 Gbps network interface. Benchmark results reveal moderate multi-core processing capabilities, achieving 11,742.55 in stress-ng multi-core tests, paired with 11.7 million Redis SET operations per second. However, single-core CPU throughput sits in lower percentiles, creating a tradeoff where single-threaded speed is sacrificed for storage density and memory volume. Cost efficiency is driven by the included local NVMe SSD capacity, which reduces reliance on external block storage. The instance is suited for database servers, key-value stores, static web serving, and log processing pipelines.
